bilingual.notes: Bilingual Education endorsement is language-specific (codes YA-YT, 17 languages). Standard 1.1 of the 2017 Bilingual Education Preparation Standards requires ACTFL Oral Proficiency Interview at Advanced Low or higher in both English and the target language. MTTC Bilingual Education exam also required.

eld.notes: ESL endorsement (code NS). Earned via an approved Educator Preparation Provider as either the initial endorsement on a teaching certificate or as an add-on, plus passage of the MTTC ESL exam. ESL preparation standards (2017, rev. 2024) do not require a separate language-proficiency exam.

sei.notes: Michigan does not mandate SEI training for all teachers. Per Michigan Law 380.1233(1) and the MDE ESL & Bilingual Placement Guide (2024), only teachers serving as the primary EL provider in ESL, sheltered English, bilingual, newcomer, or dual-language programs must hold the NS or Y_ endorsement.

history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Bilingual Education Preparation Standards revised; ACTFL OPI Advanced Low required
history.description: MDE adopted revised Bilingual Education Preparation Standards. Standard 1.1 — flagged by MDE as the most significant change from the 2004 standards — requires candidates to demonstrate ACTFL Oral Proficiency Interview at Advanced Low or higher in BOTH English and the target language. This grounds the schema's `bilingual.requirements.languageProficiency: true`.

history.title: Seal of Biliteracy adopted
history.description: Michigan adopted the Seal of Biliteracy in 2018, administered by MDE. The program recognizes high school graduates who demonstrate proficiency in English and one or more additional languages.

history.title: PK-12 Professional Knowledge and Skills standards adopted
history.description: MDE adopted the PK-12 Standards for the Preparation of Teachers (Professional Knowledge and Skills), which explicitly enumerate `linguistic` diversity and contain multiple operative references to `English learners` and `English language learners`. Subsequent revisions through 2024 retained and strengthened this language. Grounds the `professionalStandardsMentions.linguistic: true` and `.el: true` flips from the 2019 baseline.
